address: 231/3 Soi Sukhumvit 31, Khlong Toei Nuea, Vadhana, Bangkok, 10110, Thailand
bio: Chef Deepanker Khosla says of his Haoma team, We grow what we cook, we cook what we love.” And what is that? Sustainable, seasonal, local ingredients sourced from farmers, breeders, fisherfolk and the restaurant’s own garden. They’re turned into delicious, beautifully plated neo-Indian dishes that form seasonal tasting menus (including a vegetarian one). It all happens in a Nordic-style dining room where even the decor includes unused plant parts....
